name: Dense Q2 Feasibility + Capacity-First PRT Residual Overlay Spec

dense_q2_hypothesis.statement: Dense 30B/32B Q2 base may fit in 16GB RAM but produces degraded quality. PRT residual overlays can selectively restore quality while staying under memory budget.
dense_q2_hypothesis.old_prt_distinction: Old PRT = beat Q4 speed on runnable models. New PRT = recover quality for ultra-low-bit models that fit when Q4 does not.

three_layer_stack.Q2_base: capacity/runnability layer — fits in 16GB, coarse output
three_layer_stack.PRT_residual: quality recovery layer — selectively restores detail under strict memory budget

prt_residual_architecture.base: Dense Q2/Q3 stays mostly resident via layer paging
prt_residual_architecture.residual: Compressed planes/blocks stored on disk, mmaped, selected layers only
prt_residual_architecture.selection_policy: Fixed selected layers, no dynamic token routing, no top-k head routing

memory_budget.conclusion: Layer paging required even for Q2 base

execution_modes.description: Q2 + more residual if memory allows
Reduce residual set if memory pressure

residual_generation_plan.compression: ternary (-1,0,+1) or int2 or int4 planes
residual_generation_plan.storage: per-layer metadata, offline cosine/matvec validation before runtime
hard_requirements: Residual must be smaller than Q4
No sidecar larger than replaced tensor

mvp_experiment.stage_1: Small model proof-of-concept (qwen2.5:0.5B/3B) — only if it informs 30B path

recommended_next: Phase 28M: PRT residual overlay offline math spec (define representation before touching 30B files)
